gloss: to rustle; to murmur; to buzz

definitions.gloss: to rustle; to murmur; to buzz
definitions.explanation: to produce a continuous low sound of many voices or the rustling of leaves

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめいて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめいて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The classroom was buzzing with noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめいた。
examples.english: The town buzzed when it heard the rumor.

notes:
ざわめく describes continuous low-level noise, either from nature (leaves) or people (murmuring).

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (く-verb)
- Intransitive

ONOMATOPOEIC ORIGIN:
- From ⟦ざわざわ→ざわざわ：05985_zawazawa⟧ (rustling/murmuring sound)
- The ～めく suffix creates verbs from onomatopoeia

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木|き}の{葉|は}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく (leaves rustle)
- ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく (forest rustles)
- ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく (classroom buzzes)
- ⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく (town buzzes)
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく (heart stirs with unease)

USAGE:
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく describes inner unease
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ざわめく similar emotional stirring

COMPARISON WITH どよめく:
- ざわめく: Continuous, lower intensity, background noise
- ⟦どよめく→どよめく：07922_doyomeku⟧: Sudden, louder, collective reaction to an event

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ざわざわ→ざわざわ：05985_zawazawa⟧ (onomatopoeia: rustling)
- ⟦ざわつく→ざわつく：26967_zawatsuku⟧ (to be restless/noisy)
- ⟦{騒|さわ}がしい→騒がしい：17685_sawagashii⟧ (noisy)

REGISTER: Neutral to literary. Common in both conversation and writing.
